newsitem.title: UK: LCE coffee futures recover from lows, still weak.
newsitem.headline: LCE coffee futures recover from lows, still weak.

text.p: Robusta coffee futures shaved ended off lows on Thursday following light trade scale-down buying, traders said.
At the close, the benchmark November contract was off $3 at $1,561 but off a four-week low of $1,550 a tonne.
Traders said the recovery in New York prices had also helped London.
"New York has helped us once again," said one trader.
Robusta prices have remained under pressure for most of this week after the market became wary that a hefty buildup in U.S. non-commercial longs would be offloaded.
Technically, futures are due to trend sideways to slightly lower, analysts said.
Traders said origin selling had been prevalent for much of the week and would keep prices under pressure.
"Longer term we are heading south. But there are still good premiums to be had on the spreads," said another.
